storyCards.headline: Imma Be: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
The Black Eyed Peas's "Imma Be" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Imma Be" is a song by the American group the Black Eyed Peas from their fifth studio album The E.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 27 weeks on the chart.

Imma Be was released in 2009.
